worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.summary: Breathe a mystic fireball that seeks the target: on hit it deals special damage, takes 1 stage of Sp. Atk and may burn; the flame then coils around the target, biting every few ticks, and if it lasts the full time it takes 1 more stage of Sp. Atk. A target that runs far slips free. Lingering form is slower and shorter but coils far longer and burns much more; swift form is faster, longer and harder per hit.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.0: Coil around a strong special attacker and drain its Sp. Atk
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.1: Chase an evasive foe with a homing flame
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.2: Open with a burn, then grind the target down
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.descripti: The fireball deals %1$s special damage when it catches the target and takes %2$s stage(s) of Sp. Atk.
The fireball tracks a target within %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, turning %3$s degrees/tick.
On hit the flame coils for %1$s, biting %2$s every %3$s ticks; lasting the full time takes %4$s more stage(s) of Sp. Atk.
On hit there is a %1$s chance to burn the target.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.linger.on: Lingering form: coils %1$s, %2$s per bite, burn chance %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.linger.of: Swift form: coils %1$s, burn chance %2$s, and the fireball is faster and reaches further.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.growth.0: From level %1$s the fireball rises to %2$s power and the coil to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.preferenc: On: slower, shorter fireball and a lighter direct hit, but coil ×1.4, harder bites, burn chance +0.35 and +6 ticks cooldown — for coiling one target and grinding it. Off: faster, further fireball and a harder direct hit, but less coil and burn.
Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
On: it prefers targets that are not already burning (the burn and coil are worth most), and ranks burning targets last. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
